notes.title: Liminophobia on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that our game will be joining Steam Next Fest. This event gives us a great chance to show off our work. We can't wait to meet new players who will enjoy the game. You'll get to experience fresh gameplay and explore our unique world. Stay tuned for more details and get ready to join us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341052/251447e4f8ad7dbd519c8a7ffb53483682e55dbf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Liminophobia Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Liminophobia Demo is Out Now![/b]
We're excited to announce the release of our game demo. The demo offers a glimpse into our unique world. It features the first chapter where you can experience new, immersive environments. We hope you'll enjoy exploring what we've created. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop the full game!

[b]Coming Soon:[/b]
We will be joining Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition!
